You may call upon logistical support from [Black Network Organizations], and [Black Network Allies] have pledged their support as well.

entries.text: There are indications that [Black Network Enemies] have managed to plant a spy within [Black Network Organizations]. Now, since this intelligence comes to us from [Black Network Complicated] it is possible they are trying to manipulate us into suspecting one of our own unnecessarily. Only [Black Network Agents] knows of this - report only to them. If you can root out the traitor, bring them to [Black Network Locations] for interrogation.

entries.text: It has reached our ears that [MacGuffin] may be hidden in or near [Waterdeep Locations.Dungeon Locations]. [Black Network Agents] will be organizing an attempt to retrieve it, hopefully before [Black Network Enemies] or [Black Network Complicated] hear anything about it. You will be part of this expedition. If all else fails, call on [Black Network Allies] for aid.

1,[Dragon Triumvirate Agents] wants you to recover [MacGuffin] from [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies] before [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated] get it. Bring it to [Dragon Triumvirate Locations] and beware of interference from [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies].
1,Recently [MacGuffin] was stolen from [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated] by [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies]. Recover it before they do (or worse, [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies] do) and bring it to [Dragon Triumvirate Agents]. You will be assisted by [Dragon Triumvirate Organizations].
1,[Dragon Triumvirate Agents] wants you to assist [Dragon Triumvirate Allies] in a mission to disrupt the local agents of [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies], disguised as members of [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated].
1,To repay [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies] for their treachery, steal [MacGuffin] from them! Be aware that [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated] will also be trying to do so and that [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies] will do anything to prevent you from obtaining it.
1,[Dragon Triumvirate Agents] has disappeared during a mission against [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies]. Work with [Dragon Triumvirate Allies] and, if necessary, [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated] to find and recover them. 
1,A strike force led by [Dragon Triumvirate Agents] and accompanied by members of [Dragon Triumvirate Allies] is going on a raid against [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies]. Accompany them and see if you can get any assistance from [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated].
1,Although they have been allies to us in the past, it appears that [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated] are working with [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies]. Do what you can to undermine their alliance by whatever means necessary. You may call upon logistical support from [Dragon Triumvirate Organizations], and [Dragon Triumvirate Allies] have pledged their support as well.
1,[Dragon Triumvirate Agents] has old enemies among [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies] and [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies]. Now they've disappeared, and the trail has gone cold. Maybe [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated] know something about it? The last place they were seen was at [Waterdeep Locations.party] at [Waterdeep Locations.Party Locations]. 
1,[Dragon Triumvirate Agents] has received troubling reports of increased attacks on our interests by [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies], who appear to be cooperating with [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies]. They have also been targeting [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated] so there is the possibility of an alliance against these common enemies. 
1,To check the growing power of [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies], it is in our interest for you to steal [MacGuffin] from [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies] and provide it to [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated] in secret. This is the sort of thing that [Dragon Triumvirate Allies] would never approve of, so it must be done without their knowledge. 
1,Recently [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated] managed to obtain [MacGuffin], which will upset the balance of power if nothing is done. It belongs in the hands of [Dragon Triumvirate Organizations]! You will steal it, but be aware that [Dragon Triumvirate Allies] and of course [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies] will also be trying to do the same.
1,There are indications that [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies] have managed to plant a spy within [Dragon Triumvirate Organizations]. Now, since this intelligence comes to us from [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated] it is possible they are trying to manipulate us into suspecting one of our own unnecessarily. Only [Dragon Triumvirate Agents] knows of this - report only to them. If you can root out the traitor, bring them to [Dragon Triumvirate Locations] for interrogation. 
1,Members of [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies] have been seen near [Dragon Triumvirate Locations]. Work with [Dragon Triumvirate Allies] to find out who they are, what they're up to, and whether [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies] or [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated] are somehow involved. 
1,It has reached our ears that [MacGuffin] may be hidden in or near [Waterdeep Locations.Dungeon Locations]. [Dragon Triumvirate Agents] will be organizing an attempt to retrieve it, hopefully before [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies] or [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated] hear anything about it. You will be part of this expedition. If all else fails, call on [Dragon Triumvirate Allies] for aid.
1,[Dragon Triumvirate Agents] heard from one of our spies in [Dragon Triumvirate Complicated] that [MacGuffin] is hidden in or near [Waterdeep Locations.Dungeon Locations]. Take a few members of [Dragon Triumvirate Allies] with you to recover it, but do not attract the attention of [Dragon Triumvirate Enemies]. Bring it to [Dragon Triumvirate Agents] at [Dragon Triumvirate Locations] as soon as possible.

1,Recently [MacGuffin] was stolen from [Lady of the North Complicated] by [Lady of the North Enemies]. Recover it before they do (or worse, [Lady of the North Enemies] do) and bring it to [Lady of the North Agents]. You will be assisted by [Lady of the North Organizations].

entries.text: There are indications that [Lich Zulkir Enemies] have managed to plant a spy within [Lich Zulkir Organizations]. Now, since this intelligence comes to us from [Lich Zulkir Complicated] it is possible they are trying to manipulate us into suspecting one of our own unnecessarily. Only [Lich Zulkir Agents] knows of this - report only to them. If you can root out the traitor, bring them to [Lich Zulkir Locations] for interrogation.

1,[Shadow Prince Agents] has received troubling reports of increased attacks on our interests by [Shadow Prince Enemies], who appear to be cooperating with [Shadow Prince Enemies]. They have also been targeting [Shadow Prince Complicated] so there is the possibility of an alliance against these common enemies. 
1,To check the growing power of [Shadow Prince Enemies], it is in our interest for you to steal [MacGuffin] from [Shadow Prince Enemies] and provide it to [Shadow Prince Complicated] in secret. This is the sort of thing that [Shadow Prince Allies] would never approve of, so it must be done without their knowledge. 
1,Recently [Shadow Prince Complicated] managed to obtain [MacGuffin], which will upset the balance of power if nothing is done. It belongs in the hands of [Shadow Prince Organizations]! You will steal it, but be aware that [Shadow Prince Allies] and of course [Shadow Prince Enemies] will also be trying to do the same.
1,There are indications that [Shadow Prince Enemies] have managed to plant a spy within [Shadow Prince Organizations]. Now, since this intelligence comes to us from [Shadow Prince Complicated] it is possible they are trying to manipulate us into suspecting one of our own unnecessarily. Only [Shadow Prince Agents] knows of this - report only to them. If you can root out the traitor, bring them to [Shadow Prince Locations] for interrogation. 
1,Members of [Shadow Prince Enemies] have been seen near [Shadow Prince Locations]. Work with [Shadow Prince Allies] to find out who they are, what they're up to, and whether [Shadow Prince Enemies] or [Shadow Prince Complicated] are somehow involved. 
1,It has reached our ears that [MacGuffin] may be hidden in or near [Waterdeep Locations.Dungeon Locations]. [Shadow Prince Agents] will be organizing an attempt to retrieve it, hopefully before [Shadow Prince Enemies] or [Shadow Prince Complicated] hear anything about it. You will be part of this expedition. If all else fails, call on [Shadow Prince Allies] for aid.
1,[Shadow Prince Agents] heard from one of our spies in [Shadow Prince Complicated] that [MacGuffin] is hidden in or near [Waterdeep Locations.Dungeon Locations]. Take a few members of [Shadow Prince Allies] with you to recover it, but do not attract the attention of [Shadow Prince Enemies]. Bring it to [Shadow Prince Agents] at [Shadow Prince Locations] as soon as possible.
